title: Morning Smile with Pip, Lulu, and Bo
yt_description:
Join Pip, Lulu, and Bo as they brush their teeth and start their morning routine. This gentle song teaches toddlers the fun and importance of brushing teeth and getting ready for the day with a happy smile.

🎵 Morning Smile with Pip, Lulu, and Bo

Good morning sun, hello friends!
Time to start our day with smiles.

Pip picks up his toothbrush bright,
Lulu and Bo brush teeth just right.

Brush, brush, brush your teeth,
Morning smiles so bright!
Up and down, round and round,
Keep them clean and white!

Lulu puts on her boots so bright,
Bo adjusts his cap just right.

Brush, brush, brush your teeth,
Morning smiles so bright!
Up and down, round and round,
Keep them clean and white!
Good job friends, let's play all day!

Bouncy Meadow — Kids Songs with Pip, Lulu & Bo
